issues: 主体是 FakeDashboard 小卡，卡内文字 14–20px 读不清，画面在浅灰底上很空
一拍三的顿挫只有位移 + 轻微摆角，缺少“每张原画姿势不同”的手翻书味道
切换点只有角标变色，高潮瞬间没有视觉标记
帧条只是灰/靛蓝方块，看不出“摄影表”语义；冲刺段无速度表达
changes: look 换 paper：整个画面是一张动画作画纸（定位孔、淡蓝铅笔安全框/十字），主体是 5px 墨线 + 硬边赛璐珞投影的产品卡（虚构 Sprig CI · 160px「2.4x」）
一拍三 16 张原画：q = floor(f/3)·3 驱动，每步 ≈69px，每张姿势不同——摆角 ±5°、挤压/拉伸交替、一高一低小跳，投影随跳高变化
48f 两帧冲击帧：画面反相成墨底 + 以卡片为焦点的集中线（全片唯一全画面冲击），角标切「ON 1s / 1コマ打ち」并 pop 1.25×
冲刺段 out-poly(4) 高初速折返中央，scaleX 按速度拉到 ≈1.3，身后 9 条锥形墨色速度线长度随速度伸缩，过冲 40px 回弹 + 落地挤压
底部真正的摄影表：一拍三只在每 3 格写圈号、中间格画竖线（= 沿用），一拍一格格朱红圈号；hold 70f 只留 2% 极缓推进
issuesEn: The subject is a FakeDashboard card whose 14-20px text is unreadable; the light grey frame feels empty
On-3s steps only translate and tilt slightly; no sense that every drawing has its own pose
The switch is marked only by the label changing colour; the climax has no visual beat
The frame strip is plain grey/indigo squares with no exposure-sheet meaning; the dash has no speed cue
changesEn: Paper look: the whole frame is an animator's sheet (peg holes, light-blue pencil field guide), the subject a cel-style product card with 5px ink outline and hard cel shadow (fictional Sprig CI, 160px '2.4x')
16 key drawings on 3s: driven by q = floor(f/3)*3, about 69px per step, each with its own pose (tilt +-5 deg, alternating squash/stretch, high/low hop) and matching shadow
Two impact frames at 48f: the frame inverts to ink with focus lines aimed at the card (the shot's only full-frame hit); the label flips to 'ON 1s / 1コマ打ち' with a 1.25x pop
The dash uses out-poly(4) for a violent start, scaleX stretches to about 1.3 with speed, 9 tapered ink speed lines scale with velocity, 40px overshoot then a landing squash
A real exposure sheet at the bottom: on 3s only every third cell has a circled number with hold strokes between, on 1s every cell is circled in vermilion; 70f hold with a 2% creep
